author: zldalla
content:
do you guys plan on adding manual walking paces?

Like slow, medium and fast. I feel like the game punishes you a lot when you try to take it serious and don't just go balls to the wall storming rooms. Seems like an silly thing but this would be a game changer for ppl who like to plan with real cqb tactics in mind,

replying to @Daniel: 

violence of action is not always the best way of doing cqb, you have lots of things to consider if you want to actively storm rooms with armed people inside and troops skill/reflexes is one of them. 4 Marsoc storming a room are going to have a massive difference if these same 4 guys were marines or army guys. Limiting your pace is realistic and the most sane thing to do when you're NOT specialized in killing people at specific ranges

You could use nowheraki swat as an example to why storming works, but they're locals with good intent trying to protect their home, not soldiers with actual military doctrines that would slice corners or take extreme care before setting their foot anywhere. They only know violence and that's why they're good for assaults

limiting paces would also be 100% compatible with the dev's philosophy, since they always enforce how the game should be played as you wish

edit 2: i'm not asking to change the pacing mechanic either, just add options for whoever wants it like me.(edited)(edited)
